references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5 and Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) s.5: a fixed allowance paid every month for work in normal time is wage, so it enters the SSO and WCF bases; employment income under Revenue Code s.40(1).

name: Benefit in kind (housing, car, employer-paid tax)

references.title: Revenue Code ss.39, 40(1): income from employment includes money's worth and "other benefits" the employer provides — free housing, a car, and the income tax the employer pays for the employee. The monthly value (and for borne tax, the tax borne) enters the PND1 base without being paid; not SSO or WCF wage. The gross-up of a borne tax repeats by the next month's amount.

name: Piece-work wages

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.5 ("wage" includes money paid by the piece of work), s.70(1): a piece worker is paid at least monthly for the units of normal time (contract fact piece_rate, roster day fact units); units on a holiday are HOLIDAY_WORK and overtime units OVERTIME. Wage for SSO, WCF, PND1, PVD and EWF (SSA s.5, WCA s.5). Office of the Council of State English translation

eligibility: (has(terms.facts.pay_basis) && terms.facts.pay_basis == "PIECE") && sum(work.days.filter(d, !(d.holiday_kind != "" || d.day_type == "REST")).map(d, (has(d.facts) && d.facts != null && has(d.facts.units) ? double(d.facts.units) : 0.0))) > 0.0
amount: (sum(work.days.filter(d, !(d.holiday_kind != "" || d.day_type == "REST")).map(d, (has(d.facts) && d.facts != null && has(d.facts.units) ? double(d.facts.units) : 0.0)))) * ((has(terms.facts.piece_rate) ? double(terms.facts.piece_rate) : 0.0))

name: Piece worker holiday and leave pay

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.56(2)-(3): traditional and annual holidays are paid (not the weekly holiday, s.56(1)); ss.57-59: paid sick, sterilisation, military and maternity leave; s.60: for a piece worker the day is "the average wages paid … for work on the last period of payment before such holiday or leave" — read as last month's piece-work wages per normal day worked. Office of the Council of State English translation

eligibility: (has(terms.facts.pay_basis) && terms.facts.pay_basis == "PIECE") && (double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.holiday_kind != "" && d.day_type != "REST"))) + sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && !r.is_npl).map(r, r.days * r.pay_fraction))) > 0.0
amount: ((double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.holiday_kind != "" && d.day_type != "REST"))) + sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && !r.is_npl).map(r, r.days * r.pay_fraction)))) * ((has(earned.previous_month.PIECE_WORK) && has(hours.previous_month.worked_hours) && hours.previous_month.worked_hours > 0.0 ? earned.previous_month.PIECE_WORK / (hours.previous_month.worked_hours / (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) ? double(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) : (terms.work_classification == "HAZARDOUS" ? 7.0 : 8.0))) : 0.0))
